outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer and aligns its gripper with the silver handle (frames 0–85, image, left_ego_image, and wrist_image). It grips the handle and pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its interior (frames 98–117, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws while the drawer remains open through frame 176 (frames 122–176, image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
